lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.32 - A Look and learn

details: Look and learn helps students review and consolidate the main grammatical structures of the unit.

Look for accurate and confident reading and repetition of both the infinitive and the -ing form of each verb, correct pronunciation of the main vowel, as well as the contractions ‘I’m’, ‘he’s’ and ‘she’s’.
“Are you all sitting? Let’s do some drawing! Let’s draw a picture of our friends doing the things they like to do. How do we change the verb to describe what they’re doing?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.32 - B. Look and write

details: Look and write tests comprehension of the vocabulary (through observing the picture) and written production of both the vocabulary and the grammar structure.
Look for correct choice of verb, correct conjugation of the -ing form, correct spelling and neat handwriting.
“How are your pictures coming along? Can you label your picture to describe what our friends are doing?
